Fresh transfer and a revision plan

Unit 1 · Week 15 · Lesson 4 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the consolidation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Fresh transfer and a revision plan

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Apply a corrected idea using changed data. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Return to the selected error, correction and changed example. Do not use a copied answer as the only evidence. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. A small revision plan

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

The dates and priorities belong to the learner. Spaced retry supports checking whether understanding lasts. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. A changed minimum example

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

The first minimum is -7 at index 2 using a strict less-than update. An empty list needs a separate no-minimum rule. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. A changed network case

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Networks .40.0 and .41.0 differ under /24, so ordinary off-subnet traffic uses the local gateway/router. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Use changed context or values. Students keep their corrections; this is not a new graded task. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Diagnose the repeated error before adding more undirected practice. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

A clear plan identifies a skill and an observable outcome rather than a general promise to study more. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#consolidation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
